## Goal

Describe the problem and who would benefit without inventing usage claims.

## Proposed change

Explain scope, alternatives, and any effect on the results contract.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Describe an observable outcome.
- [ ] Include an offline fixture or documentation validation plan.

## Data and cost

Use only Acme Widgets and `.example` domains in examples. Do not include private
audit data, personal information, credentials, or absolute machine paths.
Explain any optional cost; no paid API or live AI engine may be called in CI.
